research_scope: Five early/base-game skills from PQ36-PQ40 selected after live repository duplicate checks. Quest placement and core classifications/costs are cross-checked where current skill-specific evidence exists; reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

records.name: Evil Whirlwind
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 36 — The Cell Games Begin
records.skill_description: Spins a leg around the user to kick nearby opponents away; the attack can also be performed while blocking.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Evil Whirlwind as a Strike Super using 100 Ki. It is also repurposed as an Evasive for Gohan (Beast), where the alternate implementation uses stamina. The canonical class is kept as Super because the PQ-acquired CaC-facing technique is the original attack classification.

records.name: Instant Rise
records.character_source: Cell Jr.; Hit; Cabba; Bojack; Zamasu; Android 13; Goku (Ultra Instinct); Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan); other characters
records.skill_description: Rapidly moves the user upward while briefly becoming difficult to target, with directional input allowing altered movement.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Instant Rise as an Other Evasive and lists a 300-stamina cost. The current reference explicitly states that it is available for CaCs. An older category table reports 200 stamina, so the specific current skill reference is treated as the preferred technical source while the historical discrepancy is retained in provenance.

records.name: Shining Slash
records.skill_description: A chargeable sword slash that can move the user directly to the targeted opponent before striking.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Shining Slash as a Strike Super using 100 Ki. It is documented as usable by Human and Saiyan CaCs and deals a single sword hit; holding the input enables the teleporting approach.

records.name: Side Bridge
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 39 — 17 and 18 of the Official Timeline
records.skill_description: Throws a Ki disc forward that returns to the user like a boomerang.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Side Bridge as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki. The projectile returns to the user and is documented as a two-hit attack. Exact CaC race restrictions and reward-slot probability are not established by the current skill-specific source, so those details remain conservative.

records.name: Heat Dome Attack
records.skill_description: Raises the hands and creates a Ki dome before firing a large vertical beam upward around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Heat Dome Attack as a Ki Blast Ultimate using 300 Ki, with 23 documented hits and approximately 40% damage in the cited reference. The PQ40 placement independently agrees with multiple PQ reward lists. This batch preserves the earlier PQ40 correction rather than resurrecting the obsolete attribution from historical research.
